tasks.short: Schedule hearings and issue their notices

steps.what: Obtain and verify the case's scheduling requirements and actual participant, interpreter and room availability, resolving missing responses directly with the responsible people.

Compare feasible hearing slots in {CALENDAR} and court case-management software {OTHER}; configure native availability and resource-conflict views to reduce repeated diary comparison, checking all proposed slots against the actual constraints.
Schedule hearings by selecting their date, duration and mode within the applicable procedural requirements, resolving exceptional conflicts and confirming the final scheduling decision.

Prepare the hearing record and notices in court case-management software {OTHER}; configure native notice fields from the chosen arrangement, then check the completed date, time zone, room or access details, service recipients and required text.
outputs: checked final hearing entry and notices

steps.what: Commit the checked final hearing entry in court case-management software {OTHER}.
inputs: checked final hearing entry and notices

steps.what: Issue the checked final hearing notices to their verified participants through the existing authorised service channel in court case-management software {OTHER}.
inputs: checked final hearing entry and notices

tasks.design: Configure native resource-conflict views and hearing notices in court case-management software {OTHER} with {CALENDAR}. The officer obtains actual constraints and chooses the arrangement before checking and separately committing and issuing the completed notice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Diary comparison and repeated notice fields can require manual coordination and copying.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calendar constraints and notice templates reuse explicit case and scheduling details.
tasks.still_hard: Procedural exceptions and conflicting participant needs require human resolution.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when an apparently free slot would prevent fair participation.
tasks.altitude: Less diary comparison and notice entry, with procedural responsibility unchanged.

reach.learn: Keep verified availability and service recipients explicit.

evidence.claim: Native calendar conflict views and case notice templates can reuse explicit scheduling details without deciding procedural exceptions.

assumptions: Boundary is the officer's existing scheduling participation through the normal hearing notices, not clerical labour performed by someone else. Shares are illustrative for an officer who does these actions.

The case file supplies case ID, required participants, hearing duration, procedural constraints and notice template/version. Participants or authorised diaries supply actual availability; the officer obtains and verifies it in s1, including manual follow-up. The officer chooses date/time/time zone, location/mode and recipients in s3-s4. Missing responses remain unresolved, not assumed available.
Native views and notices precede code. Only repeated comparison and field copying lose time; dialogue and exceptional scheduling decisions retain full effort. Existing system runtime earns no saving.

The ordinary final notice check in s4 binds the completed entry, notice text and recipients for both actions. Edits require rechecking; no additional self-approval activity. Commit and issue each retain their real one-share time. Existing service requirements remain unchanged.
research_questions: Which diary comparisons and notice fields are still repeated manually?

already_counted.description: Review proposed slots and check completed notices.

incremental.description: Maintain resource constraints and notice mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Final hearing entry checked at the end of s4
Same final hearing notices and recipients checked at the end of s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native slot comparison saves 15 hours and notice preparation 11.5, less 3 upkeep: 23.5 net. Zero if already configured. Actual availability capture, date selection, commit and issue remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review claim documents and evaluate their data

steps.what: Read the actual claim applications, certificates and physician or employer records in court case-management software {OTHER}, checking their source, identity, dates and completeness without substituting a summary for the originals.

Evaluate the document data's relevance, conflicts and evidential limitations for the case, distinguishing a party's assertion from established evidence and identifying questions still needing clarification.

Write the actual documentary assessment and unresolved questions in court case-management software {OTHER}; configure native page and document-reference links to reduce repeated citation copying, then check the completed assessment against the original documents.
Save the checked final documentary assessment entry in court case-management software {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configure native original-document and page links in court case-management software {OTHER}. The officer reads the evidence, evaluates it and writes the actual assessment; only repeated reference copying becomes shorter.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assessments can repeatedly copy original-document references by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case links preserve explicit document and page references.
tasks.still_hard: Contradictory evidence and relevance require independent adjudicative judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Keep documentary uncertainty visible and distinguish evidence from allegation.

ambition.what: No automated claim evaluation or legal outcome.

tasks.altitude: Slightly less reference entry; original reading and evaluation remain.

reach.learn: Use original evidence references without changing its meaning.

evidence.claim: Native case links can preserve document and page references without evaluating evidence reliability or legal significance.

assumptions: Boundary is documentary review and evaluation through its existing assessment entry, not determining the claim or obtaining new evidence. Shares are illustrative.

Existing case sources supply case/document ID, version, source party and actual document contents. The officer reads and verifies them in s1, forms the actual assessment in s2 and selects page references in s3. Manual matching and all substantive reading, writing and clarification remain counted. No prestructured legal conclusion or automatic document extraction is assumed.

Native page links precede code. Only repeated reference copying loses time, not legal reasoning or source verification. No summarising model or adjudication system is proposed. If links already exist, no saving.
s3's normal check of the completed entry binds the requested s4 gate without additional approval work. Edits require rechecking. Save retains one fully counted share.
research_questions: Can native links preserve source versions and pages in the officer's existing assessment?

already_counted.description: Write and check the assessment with source references.

incremental.description: Maintain source-link fields and version checks.

approvals.approved_version: Final documentary assessment entry checked at the end of s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native reference links remove 15% of the 19-hour assessment-entry share: 2.85 gross hours less 0.5 upkeep. Zero if already configured. Original reading, evaluation, substantive writing and save remain counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Authorise payment of valid claims and choose its method

steps.what: Review the actual valid-claim determination, payment entitlement and relevant case restrictions in court case-management software {OTHER}, verifying claimant identity and the current decision version.
Determine whether payment is authorised for this valid claim and select the permitted method of payment within the officer's existing authority, resolving restrictions and exceptions.

Prepare the complete payment-authorisation record in court case-management software {OTHER}; configure native fields from the valid claim and selected payment method, then check amount, currency, claimant, decision reference, method and finance recipient against the actual decision.
outputs: checked final payment authorisation and recipient

steps.what: Commit the checked final payment authorisation in court case-management software {OTHER} under the officer's existing authority.
inputs: checked final payment authorisation and recipient

steps.what: Send the recorded payment authorisation to the existing internal finance recipient through court case-management software {OTHER}.
inputs: checked final payment authorisation and recipient

tasks.design: Configure native claim fields in court case-management software {OTHER} to prepare the payment-authorisation record. The officer retains the authorisation and payment-method decisions and checks the final record before commit and delivery to finance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Authorisation records can repeat claimant, entitlement and case references already established in the file.
tasks.enabler_now: Native claim fields reuse verified details without deciding whether to authorise payment.
tasks.still_hard: Restrictions, exceptions and method suitability need authorised human judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when a valid claim still cannot be paid in the proposed manner.

ambition.what: No new payment authority or automatic bank instruction.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated authorisation entry; decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Trace an authorisation to its underlying decision
reach.learn: Keep entitlement, method and execution distinct.

evidence.claim: Native case fields can populate an authorisation record from an existing claim decision without authorising payment autonomously.

assumptions: Boundary is authorising an already valid claim and selecting payment method through internal finance handoff. It includes the actual authorisation commit, not merely recommendation. Finance execution and banking are separate and earn no saving. Shares are illustrative.

The existing adjudicated claim supplies case/claimant ID, determination version, entitlement amount/currency and restrictions. The officer verifies them in s1, chooses authorisation status and method in s2 and identifies finance recipient in s3. Manual missing-data and restriction resolution are counted; no missing entitlement or bank details are inferred.

Native case fields precede code. Only repeated field entry loses time, not claim review, authorisation judgement or final checking. Existing separation of duties is retained; this proposal does not alter adjudicative or finance authority.

The ordinary s3 check occurs after the complete authorisation exists and binds the exact amount, method, version and recipient for both actions. Changes require rechecking. No additional self-approval activity is added; commit and send each retain one fully counted share.
research_questions: Which verified entitlement and identity fields are still retyped into authorisations?

already_counted.description: Check the populated authorisation and final handoff details.

incremental.description: Maintain authorisation fields and decision-version checks.

approvals.approved_version: Final payment authorisation checked at the end of s3
Same final authorisation and finance recipient checked at the end of s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native fields remove 30% of the 33-hour authorisation preparation share: 9.9 gross hours less 1.5 upkeep. Zero if already populated. Claim review, authority decision, method selection, commit and send retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with case participants to obtain information

steps.what: Review the relevant case issues and prior participant records in court case-management software {OTHER}; configure native issue and document views to reduce repeated navigation, verifying the correct source context.
Confer with the actual individuals or organisations involved in the case, ask relevant questions and clarify their information and uncertainty under the applicable case procedure.
outputs: actual conference information and unresolved questions

steps.what: Write the actual information obtained, its source and unresolved questions in the existing case-contact note in court case-management software {OTHER}, then check the completed note against the conversation.
inputs: actual conference information and unresolved questions

steps.what: Save the checked final case-contact note in court case-management software {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configure native issue and source views in court case-management software {OTHER}. The officer retains the actual conference and writes the information obtained, without an automated account of the conversation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant case sources may require repeated navigation before a conference.
tasks.enabler_now: Native issue views can expose existing source references.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete or conflicting accounts require careful questioning.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when an answer leaves the central factual question unresolved.

ambition.what: No automated interviewing or credibility assessment.

tasks.altitude: Less case navigation; conversation and actual note writing remain.

reach.learn: Keep source attribution and uncertainty explicit.

evidence.claim: Native case views can expose relevant document references without obtaining or assessing a participant's actual information.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual information-gathering dialogue and its normal case-contact note. It is not the scheduling dialogue in task 21181 or the original-document evaluation in task 7618. Shares are illustrative.

Existing case records supply case/participant ID, issue and document references; the officer verifies and selects them in s1. Actual information is produced by the participant in s2 and manually recorded with source and contact date in s3. No prestructured conversation facts, recording or free capture are assumed.
Native views precede code. Only repeated navigation loses time, not source reading, questioning, listening or actual note writing. Missing references use retained manual search.
s3's ordinary completed-note check binds the requested s4 gate without a separate approval activity. Edits require rechecking; save retains one fully counted share.
research_questions: Can native issue views reduce navigation while preserving access to original sources?

already_counted.description: Verify the source context retrieved for the conference.

incremental.description: Maintain case-issue views and source links.

approvals.approved_version: Final case-contact note checked at the end of s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native navigation removes 20% of the 25-hour source preparation share: 5 gross hours less 1 upkeep. Zero if already configured. Actual dialogue, note writing and save retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Hearing officers retain evidence evaluation and procedural decisions while native case fields and views reduce selected scheduling and record preparation.
reach: Coordinate source-traceable case work with judicial law clerks
role.ambitious_version: Keep hearings, documentary assessments and payment authorisations traceable without transferring adjudicative authority to software.

job.title: Administrative Law Judges, Adjudicators, and Hearing Officers
